title: Max Refund Guarantee
description: If another preparer finds you a larger refund using the same documents, we'll refund your preparation fee.

title: Accuracy Guarantee
description: If a preparer error costs you IRS penalties or interest, we'll cover them — no questions asked.

title: Audit Support Guarantee
description: Get an IRS letter within a year of filing? We'll help you understand and respond to it at no extra charge.

title: Data Security Guarantee
description: Every document is encrypted in transit and at rest. Only your assigned preparer can ever open your file.
